action.name: Multiattack
entries: The hag makes two Nightmare Touch attacks.

action.name: Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) slashing damage.

action.name: Nightmare Touch
entries: {@atk ms} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}18 ({@damage 4d6 + 4}) psychic damage. If the target is {@condition unconscious}, it takes an extra 10 ({@damage 3d6}) psychic damage and is cursed until the hag dies or the curse is removed. The cursed creature's hit point maximum decreases by 5 ({@dice 1d10}) whenever it finishes a long rest.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The hag has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
